verdict.rationale: There's confirmed evidence Pulley serves a working llms.txt at help.pulley.com with structured links to help docs, directly supporting agent-oriented discovery of documentation. However, other agent-doc formats (per-page .md endpoints, OpenAPI spec) return 404s, showing the agentic documentation support is limited to this single file rather than a comprehensive agent-native docs setup. Missing for 10: per-page markdown/API-accessible docs, broader agent-oriented API surface beyond the single llms.txt file.
